disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful failure to comply with any municipal ordinance concerning the inspection of electrical work
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any licensee or business permit holder who willfully fails to comply with any municipal ordinance concerning the inspection of electrical work shall be guilty of a violation of this act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising or engaging in electrical contracting without a business permit
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any person advertising or engaging in the business of electrical contracting without having a business permit from the board is a disorderly person.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Alarm or fire protection certificate holder performing branch circuit wiring constitutes professional misconduct
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A certificate holder shall be deemed to have engaged in professional misconduct for the purposes of section 8 of P.L.1978, c.73 (C.45:1-21) for violating the provisions of this subsection.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Filing fingerprints of a person other than the applicant results in license denial or revocation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: If an applicant files with the board fingerprints of a person other than the applicant, he shall be guilty of a crime of the fourth degree and shall have his license application denied or license revoked.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Licensee knowingly falsifying information required by the board results in license revocation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: If a licensee knowingly falsifies any information required by the board, the licensee shall be guilty of a crime of the fourth degree and shall have his license revoked.

bonding_required.quote: any person engaged in the business of electrical contracting under the provisions of this act shall not undertake to do any electrical work in the State of New Jersey or any political subdivision thereof unless and until he shall have entered into bond in favor of the State of New Jersey in the sum of $1,000.00, executed by a surety company authorized to transact business in the State of New Jersey
